purpose: Bind the retained Stack-Edu and bounded Stack v3 evidence for the natural-code pretraining contrast while keeping checked exercises separate.
evidence_boundary: This manifest records retained code stock, bounded cohort results and provenance limits. It does not establish source rights, complete repository families, behavioral correctness, eligible supply or training authority.

common_contract.transformation_type: natural repository/source records; verified exercises are a separate bank
common_contract.source_family: Repository, fork, rename, derivative, benchmark and exercise families remain linked and disjoint before partitioning.
common_contract.quality_vector: Record language, role, repository context, notice/origin state, content flags and review outcomes; filename role hints are not quality labels.
common_contract.dependency_metadata: Repository/file/commit/test links are partial; unresolved commit IDs and co-present files cannot be treated as complete dependency context.
common_contract.contamination_status: open; benchmark lanes and intended repair/agent evaluation families are not fully closed.
common_contract.lineage: Preserve upstream content IDs, original Git/blob identities, decoded-text identities, consumed-text hashes, notices and transformations separately.
common_contract.unique_tokens: Report retained, held, rejected and eligible Mistral tokens separately; bounded cohort fractions are not full-release yield.
common_contract.exposure_tokens: not set; natural-code stock does not support the proposed 30B exposure before eligibility.
common_contract.repetition_count: not set; repetition cannot fill the supply gap without an explicit recipe revision.

comparison_contract.contrast: Stack-Edu versus Stack v3 natural-code route at one fixed natural-code bank share, or checked-code substitution only if independently qualified.
not_allowed: treating retained Stack-Edu tokens as eligible
using bounded Stack v3 cohort fractions as full-release yield
mixing natural code with checked exercises
accepting transformed identities without origin review
comparison_contract.study_slot: ladder families P1 (Stack-Edu score floor), P4 (code repetition) and P5 (Stack-Edu versus Stack v3); never an undeclared extra arm

required_before_use: Per-file origin and notice recovery required by the source-use decision; unresolved records stay excluded.
Complete repository/fork/rename/derivative/benchmark family graph and held-out partition.
Independent content-quality review and benchmark contamination firewall.
Eligible Mistral token count by language/role/length stratum after all holds and exclusions.
Separate checked-exercise provenance, specification, dependency, oracle and wrong-control evidence if substitution is proposed.
Measured GH200 cost and common comparison horizon.
admission_boundary: This is a launch-blocked candidate manifest. It does not admit natural code or checked exercises, authorize acquisition or change the pretraining study budget.
